message.content: As of my latest information (up to June 2024), the Governor of California was **Gavin Newsom**.  If you’re looking for the most current holder of the office—especially since elections could have changed leadership since then—I’d recommend checking a reliable news source or the official California state website for the latest updates.

But I need to check if there's any update after that. It's currently 2026-11-04. There might have been an election or change. In 2024, the next gubernatorial election would be in 2026. So it's possible that someone else became governor after 2024. However, as of my last training data up to 2024-06, the governor was Gavin Newsom. But I don't know beyond that. The user didn't specify a time frame. They likely want current info. Since I can't browse, I can provide the answer based on my knowledge cutoff and note that it may not reflect changes after June 2024. That should satisfy them.
